emerging_technology: Engineered quantum entanglement: generation, distribution and verification of entangled states as a usable resource
intended_application: Run a research pilot distributing verified entanglement and testing teleportation protocols across an existing metropolitan fiber link.
business_need: Learn whether a two-node research link can maintain usable entanglement under field conditions and support reproducible protocol experiments.
users_stakeholders: Researchers, students, network operations, grant reviewers and fiber partners
adoption_posture: Experimentally aggressive with staged, reversible research milestones
capabilities_constraints: Has quantum optics staff, photon detectors and access to a metropolitan dark-fiber segment; has no verified repeater or scalable production network.
risk_consequence_context: A controlled research pilot is reversible, but equipment cost, fiber stability, reproducibility and safety procedures matter.
management_question: Over two years, should the laboratory run a bounded two-node field pilot or claim readiness for a citywide quantum internet?
additional_context: Hypothetical organization. The same general technology classification must apply here as in the financial case. A cited 14.4 km demonstration is precedent, not a result achieved by this lab.
